notes: Three bullets, three real beats, and one clean key item in the middle -- the shape Abyssea quests are supposed to have and mostly do not. The middle step is a LOOP, not a single click: the page says to examine the flowers 'until you receive' the stamen, so the ladder cannot count attempts and does not try; holding the Gasponia stamen is what ends it. The page names the flowers only 'Gasponia' (it writes 'the Gasponia targetable location flowers'), so that bare name is what is recorded rather than a guessed 'Gasponia Flower' -- it folds to a key, and the flowers are a real targetable object, not an NPC. It gives the search area as (F-8)/(F-9) with no single point; (F-8) is recorded and both are kept in the note. The '(A)' on Yoran-Oran is the wiki's Abyssea disambiguator and the normaliser strips it. Bullet 3 writes him without the suffix; same entity. The header's 'Next: An Acrididaen Anodyne' gates nothing here and is not recorded. Fame 'aatt' is an Abyssea zone code, not one of the nine regions, so it gates nothing and only the raw survives.

notes: Bullet 1 is a precondition, not a step -- 'zone after completing the previous quest' is the standard Abyssea re-flag and folds into step 1's note. The real content of this quest is in the SUB-bullets under bullet 2: they are the only place the page says where the Sanguine Spike comes from, so the kill is promoted to a step rather than left as commentary. That is deliberate and against the usual rule that sub-bullets are commentary; here the top-level bullets would otherwise send a player to trade an item the page never tells them how to get. Gukumatz's zone is not stated outright; the page says only 'Conflux #7', and confluxes are numbered per zone, so that number identifies nothing on its own. The fight is placed in Abyssea - Misareaux because the whole quest is a Misareaux quest and Goraow stands there; no grid is given and none is invented. STAGE D: the inferred fight zone is the one soft spot in this quest and the claim that #07 is 'the Misareaux conflux' has been struck as unsupported by the page. The reward key item, Sapphire abyssite of sojourn, is a REWARD -- it proves the quest is over, not that a step is done, so it is not used as evidence anywhere. The Sanguine Spike is evidence exactly once, on the kill, and is only a held requirement on the trade.

notes: Four bullets, two steps. Bullet 1 is the usual zone-after-the-previous-quest precondition and folds into step 1's note. Bullets 3 and 4 are ONE action -- 'travel to H-8 to locate a ???' and 'touch the ??? between 16:00-18:00' are the same click, and splitting them would wedge an unmarkable travel rung in front of an unmarkable examine rung for nothing. The key item is genuinely named with its own quotation marks: res/key_items.lua 342 is "Chanson de Liberte" including the quotes, and the bare form does not resolve, so the quotes are kept. The dusk window is game time and no packet reports it, so the last step will show as ready whenever you hold the key item and stand in Zi'Tah -- a marker that is right in place and possibly early in time, which is the honest failure. The ??? can never carry a marker; the rung is kept anyway because the zone and grid are still worth drawing at. The page writes '(middle of the pos)', evidently a truncated 'pond'/'position'; it is quoted rather than guessed at. The Siren Flute is the reward and is not evidence.

notes: Two bullets and only one of them has a target. Bullet 2 -- choose <Knead>...<Knead> about thirty times -- is the dialogue menu INSIDE bullet 1's conversation, not a second entity to walk to, so the two merge into one talk step; a keyword reader would have produced a second rung with no target at all. Demoted to medium for one reason: the Description says to give President NAJA the massage, and no NPC by that name appears anywhere in the walkthrough. Either the description is flavour that the walkthrough correctly collapses into Abquhbah's menu, or the walkthrough is truncated and a second hand-in exists. The guide's rule applies -- a header field that goes unused for the whole walkthrough usually means the walkthrough is incomplete -- so the discrepancy is recorded and no step is invented for her; Naja is not named in the walkthrough and inventing her would be exactly the guessing this rebuild avoids. 'Quest Reqs: Complete all 50 Assaults and complete Aht Urhgan Mission 48' has no slot in the schema and no observable predicate, so it gates nothing and is flagged. Only the header's Previous, Promotion: First Lieutenant, is modelled. The extra Imperial Army I.D. Tag slot in the reward block is footnoted as coming from the Assaults rather than this quest; either way rewards are never evidence.

steps.note: bullet 2 is the menu inside this same conversation: pick <Knead> repeatedly, thirty times by the page's count. The header grid is the only one given. The Description names President Naja, whom the walkthrough never mentions; no step is invented for her.

notes: A clean four-rung ladder with evidence on both middle steps: the Quadav Charm off the headhunter, then the Trader's sack out of the door. Both resolve -- the charm as item 495, the sack as key item 94 -- and neither is a reward, so both are legitimate. They sit on different steps and neither repeats, so the duplicate-evidence rule is satisfied. The header's 'Item Reqs' lists BOTH, which is misleading: the sack is produced by step 3, not carried in, so only the charm is ever a held requirement. Bullet 2 is one step, not two -- 'head to Beadeaux and kill De'Vyu Headhunter' is a single journey with a single target, and a separate travel rung would only add an unmarkable step between two markable ones. The Jail Door is the weak point: the page names it only 'the Jail Door' and that is what is recorded, but doors in the client are written 'Door: X', so if the live entity is spelled that way this step loses its marker while keeping its zone, grid and readiness. It is flagged rather than guessed at. Bullet 3's 'cinematic experience' and bullet 4's 'storytelling scene' are flavour; the map, gil and experience in the reward block prove the quest is over and are not evidence.
